correctness.rationale: Headline diversity claim independently replayed from matrices: G_C1/G_C2 both rank 6 over GF(2) with 64 distinct codewords; tallies exactly {0:1,8:45,12:18} and {0:1,8:46,12:16,16:1} (sum 64, min weight 8). H matrices rank 12, GH^T=0 verified. Direct 4096-word dual tallies match exact-rational MacWilliams transforms term-by-term with zero mod-64 remainder and nonnegative integer B spectra as claimed. 13-vector feasibility census independently re-derived by exact integer DFS with interval pruning (498339 nodes in audit replay) yielding byte-identical 13 A-vectors; every vector rechecked for A0=1, sum 64, A1..A7=0, B_j>=0 integer with sum 4096. Parent lineage verified: cyclic Golay g(x)=x^11+x^9+x^7+x^6+x^5+x+1 gives G23 tally of binary Golay [23,12,7] and extended G24 tally {0:1,8:759,12:2576,16:759,24:1}; shortening G24 at {18..23} and {1,4,6,9,10,16} reproduces exactly W1 and W2 with dimension 6. d(18,6)=8 cited from live Grassl BKLC (LB 8 shortening, UB 8 Griesmer), verified live; not re-proved. Distinct enumerators rigorously imply monomial inequivalence (weight-preserving). Finite-enumeration checks are computational proofs, not heuristics.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Grassl BKLC live page for [18,6] records only LB=8/UB=8 with one shortening construction and no enumerator data; the two enumerators and any rigidity/diversity verdict are absent. Chen arXiv:2406.10825 gives weight distributions for its own infinite affine Solomon-Stiffler families, not an exhaustive [18,6] enumerator set or a two-witness diversity verdict among all optimal [18,6] codes. Huffman 2005 treats self-dual codes (k=n/2=9), disjoint from k=6. Live arXiv searches for '18,6,8 binary code' and shortened-Golay [18,6] weight enumerator return zero hits. The realized pair (W1=1+45z^8+18z^12, W2=1+46z^8+16z^12+z^16) with dual-checked spectra and the exact 13-vector MacWilliams-feasible census are not arithmetic consequences of tabled d*=8 nor a re-tally of one public matrix (C2 uses a distinct shortening set).

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: two optimal binary [18,6,8] codes with distinct MacWilliams-certified enumerators, deciding the pre-motivated rigidity-vs-diversity disjunction in the diversity direction. Object (optimal [18,6] codes on Golay shortening lineage) and invariant (weight enumerator) were motivated before computation (MacWilliams theory, shortening/residual arguments, Grassl benchmark program with crypto/storage use). Values were not known or mechanically implied by d*=8; a future researcher needs precisely these enumerators, dual spectra, and matrices as baselines/seeds. The exact 13-vector integer-feasible census is a citable companion baseline. Narrow scope (one cell, two witnesses) does not defeat value under the exact-invariant standard; certification does not rescue an arbitrary object, but this object is natural, not arbitrary. Full classification among all optimal [18,6] codes remains open and is honestly disclaimed.
